_doc: Editorial situation briefing. Update `updatedAt` whenever content changes; the UI shows it next to the briefing.

headline.zh: 1 人死亡，官方死因为病因不明的肺炎。官方称未检出鼠疫，世卫组织仍在要求俄方提供更多信息。
headline.en: One death, officially from pneumonia of undetermined cause. Officials say no plague was found; WHO is still asking Russia for more information.

known.zh: 伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所 1 名员工（28 岁）因重症肺炎于 10 月 2 日死亡。
known.en: One employee (28) of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute died of severe pneumonia on 2 Oct.

known.zh: 俄方向世卫组织通报：未登记鼠疫病例；约 5000 份检测均未检出危险病原体。
known.en: Russia told WHO no plague case is registered; ~5,000 tests found no dangerous pathogens.

known.zh: 世卫组织风险评估：伊尔库茨克中低，俄罗斯全国低，欧洲区域极低。
known.en: WHO risk: moderate-to-low in Irkutsk, low for Russia, very low for Europe.

known.zh: 约 200 名接触者曾接受医学观察，官方称九成以上已结束观察。
known.en: About 200 contacts were placed under observation; officials say over 90% have completed it.

unknown.zh: 确切病原体：官方称不是鼠疫，但尚未公布具体病因。
unknown.en: The actual pathogen: officials say it was not plague but have not named a cause.

unknown.zh: 是否存在第二名患者：世卫组织正在核实，目前未经证实。
unknown.en: Whether a second employee is ill: WHO is asking; unverified.

unknown.zh: 是否发生实验室事故：媒体报道与官方委员会结论相互矛盾。
unknown.en: Whether a lab accident happened: media reports and the official commission contradict each other.

guidance.zh: 不要自行服用或囤积抗生素：没有预防作用，还会让真正需要的人买不到药。
guidance.en: Do not take or stockpile antibiotics on your own. It does not protect you and leaves less for people who need them.

guidance.zh: 肺鼠疫及早使用常见抗生素即可有效治疗。如出现高热、咳嗽、咳血或胸痛，请尽快就医，并告知医生近期行程。
guidance.en: Pneumonic plague is treatable with common antibiotics if started early. With high fever, cough, bloody sputum or chest pain, seek care promptly and mention recent travel.

guidance.zh: 以官方通报与世卫组织信息为准，警惕未注明来源的截图和转发。
guidance.en: Rely on official and WHO updates; be wary of unsourced screenshots and forwards.
